rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8485, ALSO KNOWN AS THE ANIMAL WELFARE ACT OF 1998, SECTION 8 ON THE PENALTIES FOR THE VIOLATION OF THE ACT
rows.abstract: Proposes to impose the penalty of imprisonment of not less than two(2) years but more than five (5) or a fine of not less than P20,000 but more than P50,000 or both for violation of the Animal Welfare Act.
